thread:
sophia: Quick heads-up — launching Hosted API Stream Adapter + ToolCall v3 integrations to all accounts starting next week. This rollout is opt-in for the first 48 hours. :party-parrot:

mike: Nice! Does this include the backwards-compat routing for older tool schemas?

sophia: Yes — adapter supports legacy toolcall v1/v2 routing. New default is v3 but we auto-fallback to compatible variants if requests include old headers.

julian: Can we get the exact header we should check for in client SDKs?

sophia: Use `X-RW-Tool-Version: 3` to opt-in explicitly. If absent, adapter negotiates based on model capability.

mike: Any perf or quota changes we should call out to customers?

sophia: Not for standard quota. Streaming throughput optimized — we recommend bumping max_concurrency in client SDKs from 8 -> 12 for realtime workloads. We'll publish the suggested defaults.

platform-team: Deploy summary from prod: canary ran 6 hours, no errors above baseline, avg tail-latency down ~8% for small tokens. Ops notes attached.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: tagged release/stream-adapter-v1.2 -> prod-region-*/. Canary nodes: 12 -> 48.

mike: Docs callout needed — sample curl + streaming snippet?

docsguru: I'll push a short migration guide. Draft in #docs in 30m. Quick snippet for engineers: 
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "X-RW-Tool-Version: 3" \n  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","stream":true,"input":"summarize:..."}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-adapter
```

sophia: TL;DR for sales/CS: new adapter reduces cost per token by enabling prefix caching for tool calls and merges streaming frames to reduce round trips. Expect typical 5-12% cost improvement on tool-heavy flows.

julian: What's the deprecation timeline for v1 toolcall?

sophia: Plan: keep v1/v2 supported for 9 months. After 6 months we'll start nudges + telemetry-based bake-in. Formal deprecation notice will go out at month 8.

platform-team: Monitoring + alerts: created dashboard "StreamAdapter | ToolCall v3" under Console -> Integrations. Added SLO: 99.9% success rate for toolcall handoffs, alert if error rate > 0.5% over 5m.

mike: Do we need new SDK releases across languages?

docsguru: Yes: node + python patches going out today (v0.9.6) with header support and new default concurrency. Go and java next week.

sophia: Action items: 1) Docs publish (docsguru) 2) SDK releases (docsguru) 3) Customer comms draft (mike + cs) 4) Canary extension + metrics review (platform-team). Please ack when done.

mike: Acked, I'll draft the customer email and CS playbook.

julian: I'll validate the fallback behavior with a quick end-to-end test across regions and post results here.

sophia: Thanks — if anyone sees regressions, tag @platform-team and include request ids. Otherwise we'll flip default to opt-out (i.e., enable for everyone) after the 48h opt-in window. :rocket:
